newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Crocodile kills Dutch U.N. observer in Angola.
newsitem.headline: Crocodile kills Dutch U.N. observer in Angola.

text.p: A United Nations peacekeeper in Angola was killed at the weekend when he was attacked by a crocodile while bathing in a river in the eastern Moxico province, a U.N. spokesman said on Monday.
Sergeant Ferdinand Nieuman, a Dutch national, died on Saturday after the attack in the Cassai River near the town of Lumege where he was posted as a police observer.
"The U.N. is investigating the incident. Right now we don't have much more information," U.N. spokesman in Angola, David Wimhurst, told Reuters.
Up to 7,000 U.N. peacekeepers are in Angola helping to oversee the implementation of a peace accord between the government and former rebel UNITA after 20 years of civil war.
At least 28 peacekeepers had died in Angola since the start of the mission in 1995, mainly due to car accidents, landmine explosions and malaria.
